Hi Taylor — thanks for sending this over and for the clear notes. I pulled the spreadsheet and started a quick validation pass. A couple of small asks so we can complete the vendor master correctly:

1) Signed W-9: please attach a signed PDF of the W-9 that matches the legal name and EIN you provided. The field-level match prevents tax holdbacks during initial payments.
2) Remittance vs shipping: confirm the remit address used for AP payment (we saw a PO box and a physical address in the sheet). For payments we will use the remit address on the W-9 unless you specify otherwise.
3) Banking details: for ACH enrollment we'll need a completed bank authorization form (we can send our standard template); for now we'll set default terms to Net 30 pending bank verification.
4) PO contact: please confirm whether invoices will be submitted to invoices@tidewave.co or to accounts-payable@tidewave.co; if you use invoices@ we'll add that to the PO validation workflow.

If you can send the W-9 and confirm remit address by end of day Thursday (9/11), we should be able to create the vendor record and request our AP team to approve vendor code by 9/15. Attaching a link to our internal vendor form if you need it.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Lead
